description: The PartnerTabs interface provides a structured way to view and manage all information related to a specific partner. It organizes various aspects of partner data, such as organizational details, contact information, interaction history, funding agreements, and performance analytics, into distinct, easy-to-navigate tabs. This ensures users can quickly access the specific information they need without sifting through a single, long page.

pages.name: PartnerTabsComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for managing and viewing all details pertaining to a specific partner. It uses a tabbed interface to categorize information, allowing users to efficiently navigate between different data sets like general details, contacts, interactions, funding, and analytics. The partner's logo and basic identifying information remain visible at the top, providing constant context.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're looking for specific information about a partner, use the tabs located at the top of the content area. Each tab organizes different types of data. For example, 'Details' covers general information, 'Contacts' lists associated individuals, and 'Interactions' shows communication history. The partner's logo and name are always visible at the top for context.
common_tasks: Viewing partner details: Click on the 'Details' tab to see the partner's core organizational information.
Managing contacts: Switch to the 'Contacts' tab to view, add, or edit individuals associated with this partner.
Checking interactions: Navigate to the 'Interactions' tab to review past communications and activities with the partner.
Viewing funding: Go to the 'Funding & Agreements' tab for financial information, grants, or contracts related to the partner.
Accessing analytics: Use the 'Dashboard' tab to view performance metrics and analytical data for the partner.
Uploading logo: Click directly on the partner's logo area (if present) to upload or update the partner's official logo.
Finding a specific partner: Use the search bar or navigation outside of this component to locate the partner you wish to view.
troubleshooting: Problem: Cannot find specific partner information → Solution: Ensure you are on the correct tab. Information is categorized; for example, contact details are under the 'Contacts' tab, not 'Details'.

Problem: Partner logo not updating after upload → Solution: Clear your browser cache and refresh the page. If the issue persists, ensure the image file type is supported (e.g., JPG, PNG) and within size limits.
help_guidance.getting_started: To begin, select a partner from the main partners list. This will open the PartnerTabs view for that specific partner. You will land on the default 'Details' tab, showing general information. Explore other tabs like 'Contacts' or 'Interactions' to see different facets of the partner's profile. You can always return to the main partners list by using the breadcrumbs or navigation menu.
